bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for documentary celebrating 50 years of Frisbee sports in Minnesota.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; DOCUMENTARY CELEBRATING FRISBEE SPORTS IN MINNESOTA. +]

[+$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Minnesota Frisbee Association to produce a documentary celebrating 50 years of Frisbee sports in Minnesota. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for documentary celebrating 50 years of Frisbee sports in Minnesota.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; DOCUMENTARY CELEBRATING FRISBEE SPORTS IN MINNESOTA.

$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the Minnesota Frisbee Association to produce a documentary celebrating 50 years of Frisbee sports in Minnesota.
additions: APPROPRIATION; DOCUMENTARY CELEBRATING FRISBEE SPORTS IN MINNESOTA.
